info.title: Waypoint API
info.description: Delivery planning system for a Sri Lankan retail group.

schema.title: Response List Orders Api V1 Orders Get

get.description: Returns delivery stops for the store manager's outlet (or scoped by query param for dispatchers).

schema.title: Response List Order Stops Api V1 Orders Stops Get

get.description: Return whether cutoff is passed and whether a plan has been published for tomorrow's delivery.

schema.title: Response List Plans Api V1 Plans Get

post.description: Run all constraint validators against the plan and return violations.

Publish a DRAFT plan:
1. Validates — rejects if any ERROR-severity constraint violations exist.
2. Marks DRAFT → PUBLISHED, supersedes previous PUBLISHED plan.
3. Advances order statuses: QUEUED/CONFIRMED → PLANNED.
4. Sets Trip status to PLANNED (→ ready for loader to start LOADING).
5. Broadcasts notifications to all loaders.
6. Records audit log entry.

schema.title: Response List Deferrals Api V1 Deferrals Get

get.description: Returns the deferral history for a specific outlet (via its orders).

schema.title: Response Outlet Deferral History Api V1 Deferrals Outlets  Outlet Id  History Get
Response List Loading Trips Api V1 Loading Trips Get

post.description: Mark that vehicle loading has physically started at the bay (PLANNED -> LOADING).
Release vehicle after loading is complete (PLANNED/LOADING -> LOADED).

get.description: Return the driver's active trip (LOADING, LOADED, or IN_TRANSIT).

schema.title: Response Current Trip Api V1 Driver Trips Current Get

post.description: Mark the driver's current trip as IN_TRANSIT (LOADED -> IN_TRANSIT).

schema.title: Response Sync Events Api V1 Driver Sync Post

post.description: Store one GPS fix from the driver's device for the vehicle they are assigned to.

get.description: The most recent fix for each vehicle that has reported one.
